target_customer: Merchants selling clean energy products (starting with EV chargers) and, through them, homeowners
problem: Government and utility rebates are complicated and rarely shown at purchase, so buyers miss them; Upfront applies the rebate at checkout and handles claims and settlement.
business_model: Software for merchants that applies rebates at checkout and settles with issuers; Shopify app listed
product_category: Clean energy rebate checkout and settlement

founders.name: Thomas Stephens
education: Stanford University, M.S. and B.S. in Management Science and Engineering
founders.background_notes: Launcher and GM at DoorDash, expanded into US suburbs and Australia and Japan (YC page).

founders.name: Andrew Hoskins
founders.background_notes: Engineer building servicing and payment systems at Affirm (YC page).

exit.reason: YC lists as inactive; tryupfront.com returned 503; no public cause

competitors.name: Qmerit
competitors.what: EV charger installation marketplace that added incentive estimates and automaker incentive processing
competitors.traction_then: Processed automaker charger incentives for thousands of EV buyers by end of 2022

technical_complexity.rationale: Real time eligibility across many utility and government programs, checkout integration and settlement with issuers; the hard part is rebate data and program operations rather than software.

defensibility.rationale: Rebate program data and issuer relationships take time to build, but merchants could switch to another provider.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Qmerit already surfaced incentives in estimates in late 2022; Treehouse raised $10M in Aug 2023 for EV charger incentives; no source on direct action against Upfront.

market_need_then: The Inflation Reduction Act era increased federal, state and utility EV charger and clean energy incentives; the founders say they found rebates hard to claim as new homeowners.

branding.domain_note: Uses tryupfront.com (a prefix domain, not upfront.com).

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain benefit statement, launch post title uses a lightning emoji

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word shared with TV advertising upfronts and other firms, which crowded search results; no brand specific press found.

outcome_analysis: Upfront targeted rebates at checkout for EV chargers and had a partner announcement with a charger retailer, but the YC directory lists it inactive and no shutdown explanation or later funding was found, so the cause is not public. Rebate programs are fragmented and incentive demand shifted with policy after 2024, but no source ties the outcome to a specific factor.
notes: The $500K pre-seed rests on one aggregator (Employbl, Diffbot data). The YC short description says personal assistant for home projects while the launch post and later sources describe rebates at checkout; the order and dates of that change are not sourced, so no pivot is recorded. A VCBacked page named Upfront is a different New York real estate company and was excluded. A Shopify app listing by Upfront Energy Inc is consistent with the rebate product but was not confirmed as the same company.
